title: Actual internal oplax components on K-flat resolving models
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $T$ use its small pro-étale site, small relative to module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the pulled-back ring object $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and its reconstructed section-ring sheaf, and the fixed exact internal/section module equivalence $E_T$ [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the ordinary operations and universe convention of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data]. Let $q_T^{\mathrm i},q_T^{\mathrm s}$ denote the internal and section homotopy-to-derived localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and write $\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm i},\mathcal P_T^{\mathrm s}$ for the full subcategories of K-flat complexes with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], with the corresponding exact-tensor and acyclic-total-tensor tests internally. All total tensors below are signed direct-sum cochain totals [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and all derived tensors are relative to $R_T$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $F=f^*_{\mathrm{sec}}$, and $LF$ the specified total derived section pullback with comparison $\epsilon_A:LF(q_Y^{\mathrm s}A)\to q_X^{\mathrm s}(FA)$ of [def-pd-section-derived-realization]. Use the derived pullback comparison $\gamma:D(E_X)Lf^*_{\mathrm{int}}\cong LF D(E_Y)$ of [lem-pd-section-derived-pushpull-normalization], compatible with these resolution transformations, and the normalized $\theta_T,e_T$ of [lem-pd-section-kflat-tensor-comparison]. Write $F_{\mathrm i}=f^*_{\mathrm{int}}$ and $L_{\mathrm i}=Lf^*_{\mathrm{int}}$, with resolution transformation $\eta_A:L_{\mathrm i}q_Y^{\mathrm i}A\to q_X^{\mathrm i}F_{\mathrm i}A$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $b^{\mathrm i}_{A,B}:F_{\mathrm i}\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes B)\to\operatorname{Tot}(F_{\mathrm i}A\otimes F_{\mathrm i}B)$ and $u^{\mathrm i}:F_{\mathrm i}(R_Y[0])\to R_X[0]$ be the actual total tensor and unit arrows of [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors]. Let $\delta^{\mathrm i}$ and $v^{\mathrm i}$ be their already specified localized transformations, using the internal tensor localization and total derived pullback; they are not newly chosen transformations. For $A,B\in\mathcal P_Y^{\mathrm i}$, $F_{\mathrm i}A,F_{\mathrm i}B$ belong to $\mathcal P_X^{\mathrm i}$ and all three $\eta_A,\eta_B,\eta_{\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes B)}$ are invertible. With the internal K-flat representative maps $r_T^{\mathrm i}$, put
$$a^{\mathrm i}_{A,B}=\eta_{\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes B)}\,L_{\mathrm i}((r_Y^{\mathrm i})^{-1}),\qquad c^{\mathrm i}_{A,B}=(r_X^{\mathrm i})^{-1}(\eta_A\otimes^{\mathbf L}\eta_B).$$
These maps are invertible and the components of the specified lift satisfy
$$c^{\mathrm i}_{A,B}\delta^{\mathrm i}_{q_Y^{\mathrm i}A,q_Y^{\mathrm i}B}=q_X^{\mathrm i}(b^{\mathrm i}_{A,B})a^{\mathrm i}_{A,B},\qquad v^{\mathrm i}=q_X^{\mathrm i}(u^{\mathrm i})\eta_{R_Y[0]}.$$
The regular degree-zero unit is resolving. The displayed equations are natural in both homotopy-category variables and remain valid after inversion of their quasi-isomorphisms. They concern the actual localized internal arrows and impose no boundedness or flatness on the coefficient map.

proof.text: Identify the acyclic right-total-tensor test in internalResolving with homotopy K-flatness using HomotopyCategory.kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic, the quotient acyclicity criterion and braiding. Conversely, the same criterion recovers the acyclic test from K-flatness. The module-object inverse image preserves K-flatness by [lem-sfb-proetale-internal-pullback-kflat]. Extension along the actual condensed coefficient pullback is an equivalence, so the existing monoidal-equivalence K-flat preservation theorem and the termwise composition isomorphism give K-flatness for the full internal pullback. Its PreservesFlat instance transports term flatness; braiding identifies the two exact-tensor tests. Thus the full pullback preserves internalResolving.

proof.text: Apply the existing generic isIso_leftDerivedFunctorCounit_app_of_kFlat theorem to each resolving homotopy object and to the tensor of two such objects. Homotopy K-flat objects are closed under tensor. The generic localization tensor comparison is invertible when one factor is K-flat. Expand the two existing derived tensor counits: comparisonA is the image of that localization tensor map followed by the pullback counit, and comparisonC is the tensor of the factor counits followed by the localization tensor map at their pullbacks. The preceding K-flatness statements make both comparisons invertible.

proof.text: The specified mate monoidal structure agrees with the canonical structure: apply Monoidal.toOplaxMonoidal_injective to internalPullOplax_eq_canonical from [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors]. After this identification the definition of internalDelta is exactly the existing leftDerivedTensorComparison. Its proved leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_counit equation, uncurried, is the required component equation. The regular complex is resolving by the regular-unit clause of [lem-pd-section-kflat-tensor-comparison]. Unfold the specified leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso and actualInternalTotalUnit and remove the identity mapHomotopyCategoryFactors comparison: their homs are the same pullback counit followed by the homotopy quotient and derived localization of the degree-zero ordinary unit comparison.

proof.text: For a resolving pair quasi-isomorphism s, both derived bifunctors invert its components since Qh inverts quasi-isomorphisms. Naturality and the invertible endpoint comparisonA and comparisonC components transfer invertibility to the two homotopy total functors. For each of the four natural transformations, choose asIso of its actual functor images of s. Cancel the source image from the naturality equation and compose with the target inverse to obtain the inverse square. This proves the four inverse-square assertions without any new localized transformation.

lean.statement: theorem internal_oplax_resolving_components {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Functor.ResolvingOplaxComponents (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f) (KFlatSectionComparison.internalResolving Λ Y) (KFlatSectionComparison.internalResolving Λ X) (internalDelta Λ f) ∧ KFlatSectionComparison.internalResolving Λ Y (𝟙_ (CochainComplex (internalModules Λ Y) ℤ)) ∧ (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso Λ f).hom = (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (𝟙_ (CochainComplex (internalModules Λ Y) ℤ))) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (actualInternalTotalUnit Λ f)
lean.note: Generic predicates package precisely the existing derived counit composites and the specified internalDelta, retaining naturality as natural-transformation types and explicitly asserting the inverse quasi-isomorphism squares. The actual ordinary total unit and the already specified derived unit are compared directly. No arbitrary lift, replacement tensor, additional flatness or boundedness assumption is introduced.
